name: webmcp-enable
description: Build and verify browser WebMCP tools for website workflows using editable source or a session-local adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify WebMCP tools for real website workflows
interface.longDescription: An instructions-only skill for adding, repairing, or verifying browser WebMCP integrations. Reuse existing forms and application logic when source is available, or build narrowly scoped, session-local adapters for accessible websites. Preserve validation, authentication, confirmation, and ordinary UI behavior. Report implementation, mocked checks, native-browser verification, and target-agent verification separately. Browser capabilities and authorized access limit coverage; this plugin does not install a browser extension or provide an MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use $webmcp-enable to add WebMCP to this website project.
Use $webmcp-enable to create a session-local adapter for this website.
Use $webmcp-enable to diagnose this website's WebMCP integration.
